C12, C07, and C25 are the closest because they direct multiple federal agencies or department heads to provide assistance or take action, but those are generic administrative mechanisms used for materially different programs and do not plausibly supply a concrete drafting template for the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby direct the heads of the departments, agencies, and independent establishments of the executive branch of the Government to take such action as may be practicable","parent_excerpt":"The Department of State, the Department of the Army, and such other agencies of the Government as the Displaced Persons Commission may request, shall... furnish the Commission such assistance as it may need","explanation":"C12 similarly directs federal agencies to assist an assigned program, but the resemblance is a routine interagency-cooperation clause rather than distinctive shared drafting."},{"child_excerpt":"the heads of the departments, agencies, and independent establishments of the executive branch of the Government","parent_excerpt":"Each of the departments, establishments, and agencies in the executive branch of the Government shall institute and set in operation, as soon as practicable, the plan","explanation":"C07 has the closest vocabulary and an executive-branch-wide operational direction, but its committee-administered payroll-savings machinery and sequence are absent from the child."},{"child_excerpt":"I hereby direct the heads of the departments... to take such action as may be practicable","parent_excerpt":"The head of each department in the executive branch of the Government shall be personally responsible for an effective program","explanation":"C25 also assigns implementation responsibility across department heads, but its detailed fair-employment enforcement structure does not appear in the child."}]}
